_meta.description: What AI DOGE holds for every principal council and other public body in England, next to what each body publishes. Generated mechanically from the source registry and the ETL output.
_meta.denominator_note: Principal councils are the 5 classes SD, UA, MD, LB and SC. Combined authorities, fire authorities, police bodies, national parks and waste authorities are tracked separately and must never be added to a council count.

status_meanings.live: Spending data published on the site
status_meanings.ingested: Spending data processed, not yet published
status_meanings.archive: Raw source files held, not yet processed

_meta.on_site_note: Status describes spending data only. `on_site` records whether the body has a page on the site, which some do without any spending data behind it.

summary.totals_caveat: Row counts and spend sums are pre-deduplication upper bounds. Some councils' files load duplicate rows; the figures are a ceiling on what is held, not a measured total.
